lines.en: label norikodorm30:
Now that Noriko is (At least presumably) not spending her free time on the bed where I deflowered her roommate, the time has come for me to hoist upon her an inconvenient truth.
Or to pretend that I am going to do that only to back out once things become too hard or uncomfortable.
Or to find a middle ground that allows me to speak somewhat seriously to her while still managing to conceal the most important, life-altering bits of information I currently possess.
Or to just make out with her and entirely forget and/or disregard that I have serious things to discuss altogether.
One of those things is very likely going to happen.
But none of them at all will happen if she doesn’t answer the door.
: Noriko, I know you’re in there. I can hear your music.
: Hm? Is someone there? I had my headphones on.
: Let me in.
: Sensei? Why would you not just open the door? I have literally never locked it before.
: Because nice and considerate are character traits I have earned throughout my time here and the fact that I am willing to wait outside and not barge in is a subtle nod to my character development.
: Or at least it was before you went and ruined everything.
: I have no idea what you’re talking about, but you’re welcome to come in!
scene black
: Thanks. Was that so hard?
scene norikoknows1
: The hardest part of all was just realizing you were at the door. If it weren’t for every Charles Bronson song being nine seconds long, I would have never even noticed.
: That is not enough time for a song.
scene norikoknows2
: Tell that to the entirety of the powerviolence genre. So, what brings you here today? Ready to pick up where we left off on the beach?
: Are you ready to pick up where we left on the beach?
scene norikoknows3
: Of course. I would have had sex with you right then and there if it weren’t for your incessant desire to always make Maya happier than you make me.
: And if that sounded passive aggressive, it’s because it was.
: But thank you again for the orgasm.
: Okay, I think we need to talk.
scene norikoknows4
: Is it going to be a good talk or a bad talk? Because Kirin’s been really nice to me ever since the love hotel and it’s been putting me on edge.
: It’s a talk about...the past, present, and future. I’m going to have one with Maya soon too. And I just had one with your sister the other day.
: Isn’t it a little too early for your midlife crisis, Sensei? Because it’s either that or you’re about to go all “Big Fish” on me and I’m not in the mood to cry today.
: You’re probably going to cry today.
scene norikoknows5
: Damn it! This was supposed to be my good luck band! I wore my nice underwear and everything!
scene norikoknows6

: Which isn’t to say that all of my underwear isn’t nice. It is. And you’re free to help yourself to another pair whenever you like if the one I gave you earlier is starting to get worn down by all the friction.
: Noriko, take a seat.
: If you’re about to Chris Hansen me...I swear to god, Sensei. Which doesn’t mean much considering I’m neither religious nor a child predator, but still.
: Just sit down. There are a few things I want to talk about and it...might wind up taking a little while.
scene black
Noriko sighs, removing her headphones and placing them down on the kotatsu before hopping onto the bed and pulling her knees up to her chest.
scene norikoknows7
She stares at the wall for a moment, somehow managing to keep a smile plastered to her face despite the obvious red flags that both Kirin and I have been waving in front of her.
And while I’m more or less settled on the fact that I am going to tell her about what happened between Niki and me the other day, there’s something I need to bring up first.
Especially since, as of right now, the only people I have confirmed to actually know my name are Niki and Otoha. And Otoha being on that list is extremely strange to me.
If I can confirm Noriko is on it as well, it will at least make me feel a little bit better.
And that I may also be subconsciously favoring the second floor as I haven’t bothered confirming that information with any of my original students yet.
: Okay...hit me.
: I didn’t realize you were into that.
: You totally know I’m into that.
: You’re right, I do. But before we deep dive into any more of your fetishes, there’s something I need to know.
scene norikoknows8
: My heart is an open book with a frayed spine. If it’s something I know, it won’t be hard for you to find out.
: Do you know my name?
scene norikoknows9
: Your name?
: Of course. It would be weird if I didn’t.
: Then...why have you kept calling me Sensei this whole time?
: I...haven’t?

: Like, yeah...I call you that more than anything else since I figured reinforcing the faux power dynamic your title creates would tempt you more, but I’ve called you by your regular name a bunch of times.
: Do you really not remember?
: Uhh...no?
: Would it help you if I said it now?
: It might. But I’m sorry in advance if I wind up tackling you or drooling on your blanket as a result of that.
scene norikoknows10
: Akira Arakawa — thirty-one years old. Lifelong friend and the first love of my life.
: Ex-boyfriend of Niki Nakayama. My surrogate brother and future daddy if all goes according to plan.
: Okay. You can stop right-
: A man who’s been put through the wringer and still manages to get out of bed every morning and pretend he’s not all broken up inside.
: He might be a bit of a pervert. And he might be sleeping with a bunch of teenage girls. But beneath the ephebophilia and blank stare, he’s actually a really great guy.
: Or can be, but just decides not to be most of the time because he’s afraid of people liking him more than he thinks he deserves.
: Hobbies include long walks on the beach and talking to plants.
: Now you’re just making things up.
: Are you testing me or something? Why was I suddenly quizzed on the same name I’ve been scribbling next to mine in notebooks ever since I learned how to write?
: Because I finally remembered it. Or...was told it?
scene norikoknows11
: You didn’t even remember your name?...
: Nope.
: But...what about your bills? Or ID? Or credit cards? Or...what about Ami? She doesn’t call you Sensei while you guys are alone at home, does she?
: She does, and I have no idea where my ID even is. All of my mail just has my last name on it.
: That makes...basically no sense at all. Are you sure you’re not just...overlooking it? Like how you apparently were all of the times I’ve called you Akira?
: That wouldn’t-
: It would make more sense than thinking every document that’s ever been sent to your house just says “Arakawa” on it, wouldn’t it?
: Hey, I don’t know how Kumon-mi handles mail. For all I know, that’s normal here.
: What about Nee-chan? Surely she’s been calling you Akira this whole time. That’s how we always refer to you when we talk, and we talk about you a lot.
: She’s actually the one I first heard it from.
: When?
: Well...when was the last time you saw her?
: Not since right before Christmas. I think she’s still kind of mad at me for skipping out on her holiday concert this year.
: Well, it was sometime after that.
: Have you seriously been just living without a name this whole time? Wasn’t that a little...I don’t know, dehumanizing?
: If I was just suddenly “Girl” and everyone only called me “Girl” I’d probably lose myself entirely.
: What you have to realize is that I’ve been “Sensei” this whole time. It’s the first thing I heard when I woke up and it’s what everyone’s come to know me as.
: That has always been my name as far as I’m concerned. Which is why it’s so strange and unsettling for me to finally have a real one.
: Noriko?
: I’m sorry, I just don’t really understand. Why is it just now dawning on you that you’re an actual person?
: What happened with Nee-chan that helped you remember? She must have done something, right?
: That’s...the main thing I wanted to talk about today.
scene norikoknows12
: Oh...no. No...
: I don’t like that opening, Sen...Akira.
: At least you get to find out from me directly rather than her this time.
: Can’t we just say I aced the name quiz and have a celebratory make out session? You know, without breaking my heart again?
: Something did happen between your sister and me.
: Sensei-
: She helped me remember how important the two of you are.
: She helped me remember that you’ve been there from the beginning and that, unless something’s different with you, you’ll both be there until the very end.
: That I can always count on the two of you to stay by my side and that, even if I don’t remember how things were back then, I did something horrible by abandoning you.
: You’re not the only one here who’s a work in progress, Noriko. And that’s painful to admit since I’m twice your age...but I’m doing that now.
: I want you and your sister to play more important roles in my life...and I want to go back to however things were in the past before any of this existed to either one of us.
: But time won’t turn back that far, so I’m stuck here and now and...need to start again. And I want you there for that. I want you there to see Akira and not Sensei.
: I’ve seen Akira this whole time...Sensei is who you saw...
: In order to keep you close, though...I have to hurt you again.
: It probably won’t be the last time, but seeing as you’ve already been through enough pain because of me, the least I can do is be honest this time around.
: I had sex with your sister.
: I love her.
: Nori-
scene norikoknows13
: FUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUCK!!!!
: DAMN IT!!!!
: Uhh...
: I KNEW THIS WAS GOING TO HAPPEN! GOD FORBID I EVER WIN AT ANYTHING WHEN SHE EXISTS! AND JUST WHEN I THOUGHT I FINALLY HAD A LEG UP!
: Okay, good. Let it all out.
scene norikoknows14
: That’s basically everything.
: There’s no way that’s “basically everything.” You cried hysterically when you found out I fingered her.
: And I’ll probably cry today when you leave the room. But right now, I’m just pissed off at myself for letting you leave that night on the beach when it could have been me instead.
: Because not only did you have sex with my sister before me, but you also got to hear your name from her and that seems like a huge deal if everything you said earlier is true.
: It was a big deal. And it’s right for you to be mad at me.
scene norikoknows15
: Listen, I’m obviously pissed off, but it’s not at you, okay?!
: It’s not?
: No! Of course not! I’m super happy for both you and Nee-chan! My frustration isn’t some kind of protest to that!
: You two have been in love with each other my whole life! It’s amazing that you finally took things to the next level after all this time and I’m really glad things are working out!
scene norikoknows16
: I just got my hopes up a little too much...you know...that it would be me instead. But I’m one step behind like always and there’s nothing left for me to do but once again chase after both of you.
: You won’t have to chase me far. I’ve learned my lesson when it comes to putting too much space between us.
scene norikoknows17
: You say that, but I still don’t know what this means for you and me.
: Things were finally starting to move forward and now there’s no reason for you to even come at me anymore. What am I supposed to do?
: You don’t have to do anything. I’m still going to “come at you.”
: But...Nee-chan-
: Will love me no matter what I do. And, as fucked up as it sounds, I’m sure she’ll understand if things continue progressing for you and me as well.
scene norikoknows18
: Maybe for you. Nee-chan would get pissy whenever I even tried her clothes on. I don’t want to imagine what she’ll do to me if I have sex with her boyfriend.
: I mean...it’s not like we have to tell her?
: Does she not deserve the same level of honesty that I do?
: Why do I have to be the one to hear about the other end of your relationships while she gets to keep living in her own little world? That’s not fair at all.
: Because I think you can take it...and, I think it’ll help you grow up.
: Niki’s a special case. I know that you both spent years looking for me, but she’s-
: Mentally incapable of ever moving past you?
: Exactly.
: And you think I am?
: I do.
: And I think you should.
: There are tons of people out there better suited to you than I am.
: You’re a borderline-genius who excels at basically everything you try to do...and you have an extremely bright future ahead of you if you just keep applying yourself.
: All I can do is hold you back.
: My future doesn’t matter if you’re not in it, Akira.
: It does, though.
: Niki and I both have a lot of faith in you and just want you to...find all the pieces of yourself so you can be even more amazing one day.
: Stop talking like you two are married already. It’s making me jealous.
: Noriko, if you want things to keep moving further for us, I’ll make it happen. But it’s only going to hurt you more and I feel like that’s all I ever do with you now.
scene norikoknows19
: If you knew even half of what you actually do for me, there’s no way you’d be saying that.
: The reason I made it as far as I’ve had is in no small part to all the help you’ve given me...and how motivated it made me to succeed just so I could have a shot with you one day.
: If that shot is still there, I want to take it.
: I want to kiss you in your office.
: I want to suck your dick in a bathroom stall.
: I want to get fingered on a school bus...fuck you on a table somewhere.
: I want to finish growing up with you because you’re the main reason I decided to grow up in the first place.
: If you’re telling me that’s not possible...and that you refuse to ever look at me as anything other than Niki’s sister...fine. I’ll try moving on. I’ll absolutely suck at it, but I’ll try.
: But...if you’re telling me that the only thing preventing that from happening is your “desire for me to live a more fulfilling life” or how “you don’t want to hurt me,” you can fuck right off.
: The one who chooses where my life leads is me. Letting you make decisions like that for me just means I’ve given up.
: So...you’re saying-
: I’m saying that if there are going to be mistakes I make in life, which I know there will be...
: I want one of those mistakes to be you.
: As soon as possible...
: Before you and Nee-chan get even further away...
: The next time I invite you over to my house, I’ll try to talk you out of this one more time.
: If you refuse me again then...
: We can change things once and for all.
: And I can cement myself as the single greatest regret you will ever have.
: Show me the dotted line and I’ll sign it.
: I’m sure it means nothing after whatever you went through with Nee-chan, but I love you just as much as she does.
: I’ll never regret you no matter how much you think I should.
: Okay...
: Okay...
: I should probably leave. That was a good note to end things on.
: Okay. Holding back the tears has gotten pretty tough anyway and I’d like to let the dam burst now.
: I’ll call you soon.
: I’ll be waiting.
scene black
: I’ll start preparing my speech when I get home.
: Goodnight, Noriko.
: Goodnight...
: Akira.
I leave the room and move further away from the comfort it provides-
But make it one step closer to a life so full of missteps that we’ll all be moving backwards.
